translations.web: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
translations.bsb: Behold, God is exalted in His power. Who is a teacher like Him?
translations.kjv: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth
translations.asv: Behold, God doeth loftily in his power: Who is a teacher like unto him?
